query: SELECT DISTINCT npc_agent.character_id AS "character_id!: i64" FROM action JOIN speech ON speech.action_id = action.id JOIN message ON message.action_id = speech.action_id JOIN history_entry ON history_entry.id = message.id JOIN agent_history ON agent_history.branch_id = history_entry.branch_id JOIN npc_agent ON npc_agent.agent_id = agent_history.agent_id JOIN character_group ON character_group.character_id = npc_agent.character_id WHERE action.requesting_tool_execution_id = ? AND npc_agent.character_id <> speech.speaker_character_id AND character_group.group_id = ?
